items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I wouldn't be in the band. No, I would have quit, like Herbie ...(?). . .(?). . . And Herbie hasn't done too much since that.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was a wild crew in that band.

Oh God! That was unbelievable, that band. Guys nodding out and all that. I wouldn't be in the band. No, I would have quit, like Herbie ...(?). . .(?). . . And Herbie hasn't done too much since that. He can still play, though. He lives around Frisco.
